summary:
The "final" branch mostly keeps the project's hard lines, but I found one break that should be fixed before merge and one pre-existing staging problem in the gift box; four more points are owner decisions.

The break (must): a weekly gift that the player has earned (five of seven tasks done) but not yet collected with the "주간 선물 받기" button is silently thrown away when the week changes. On Sunday the sheet showed 5/5 and the chip had its dot; on Monday the list was replaced, shells were unchanged, and nothing was said. The sheet's own text promises "못 해도 잃는 건 없어", and a reward that disappears if not collected by Monday is a small "놓치면 사라지는" mechanic (hard line 5).

The staging problem (should, already in production): when the octopus declines an offered hat, the code puts the half-lidded "calm" face on it for four seconds. The salon deliberately uses the neutral face for the same kind of answer.

What holds, confirmed by playing it in a browser (360x740 and 320x568, touch):
- Weekly to-do: only asking counts, a stay-home answer counts the same as a walk, it stops at 2, pressing the button while the octopus is out does not count, and a completed walk paid 0 shells and 0 seeds. An unfinished week changes silently, with no countdown, warning or "missed" mark. The chip dot is a static 8 px square.
- Gift box: a "no" stood for the day in every path I tried (asking again, reload, a second tab on the same day, a lost record), because the answer is seeded by day, item and name. Refusal and acceptance lines state only the decision, and the log row is marked "(데모 규칙이 고름)".
- Garden: nothing wilted after 20 skipped days; seeds cannot be bought; the flower colour is fixed at planting, so it is not a gacha.
- Set collection: no reward, all parts free, found by wearing.
- Salon upstairs: a napping octopus is neither moved nor woken (three mirror taps gave only "지금은 아래층에서 자고 있어."). A "그대로" answer is staged plainly up there (neutral face, colour unchanged, nothing paid, "내일 또 물어볼 수 있어."). At 320x568 the lifted scene keeps mirror and octopus above the sheet.
- Strings: 66 new literals contain only Korean, ASCII, the middle dot and the ellipsis, with no feeling words about the octopus; the font check says "stale: none".
- Sound: with sound off, no AudioContext was created and nothing under audio/ or foley/ was requested in any run.

Owner decisions: (1) the octopus is placed upstairs whenever the player climbs, including in its drowsy window before a nap, and the nap waits while the player stays up; (2) "이번 주에 사흘 들어오기" is a login-count task; (3) the tasks "문어한테 산책 갈지 묻기" and "선물 상자에서 하나 내밀기" pay toward shells, and the first also counts when the press wakes a napping octopus; (4) a gift "no" lasts one day and the toast invites asking again tomorrow, while the salon rests a declined colour for 7 days.

One caution for anyone reading screenshots: Playwright page screenshots taken with the salon sheet open show a black block over the top of the scene. It is a capture artifact; the canvas buffer read directly is complete. The machine was loaded (load average 10 to 34), so I used no wall-clock timings as evidence. The reviewed tree is clean (only the untracked node_modules link). Everything is in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-welfare/ (notes.md, scripts t*.js, logs t*.log, screenshots).

findings.title: An earned but uncollected weekly gift is silently discarded when the week changes
findings.where: /home/user/ppolppol-merge/js/app.js:4288-4296 (weekState replaces the week), :4310 (weekClaim is the only place the gift is granted), :4318 (the text "못 해도 잃는 건 없어"); screen: 살림 sheet, section 이번 주 할 일
findings.what: When five tasks are done the player must press "주간 선물 받기 (조개 12 · 씨앗 2)". If the week changes first, weekState() builds a new list and the old week is dropped with claimed=false. The player gets nothing and is told nothing. It should be impossible to lose an earned gift: the sheet says nothing is lost, and the author's stated rule is "nothing is lost". As built, the gift has a Monday 00:00 deadline, which is the kind of expiring reward hard line 5 forbids.
findings.evidence: t1c.log C1: Sunday 2026-11-15, 5/5 done, claimed false, shells 20, chip has-gift true. Same tab on Monday 2026-11-16 after opening the bag: week key 2026-11-16, 0/5, shells 20, toast empty. C1b (fresh load on Monday): shells 23, which is only the daily +3; toasts seen: []. C2 (claimed on Sunday): shells 32, seeds 3. Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-welfare/t1c-C1-bag-claim.png and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-welfare/t1c-C1-monday-bag.png
findings.repro: export NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g); node /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-welfare/t1c-week.js (blocks C1, C1b, C2). By hand: seed S.user.week with five done tasks and claimed false, set window.__ppolTest.today to a Sunday, load, then change to the next Monday and open the 살림 sheet.
findings.suggested_fix: Grant the gift without a button: either at the moment the fifth task completes (in questMark, with the existing toast), or in weekState() before replacing the old week (if the old week has five done and is not claimed, add the shells and seeds and show one plain line such as "지난주 선물: 조개 12 · 씨앗 2"). With either, the chip dot and the claim button can go. Not tested by me.

findings.title: Gift box refusal puts the half-lidded "calm" face on the octopus (already in production)
findings.where: /home/user/ppolppol-merge/js/app.js:3257 (`else expressRow('calm')`); screen: attic, after 설정 › 문어 선물 상자 › 내밀기
findings.what: When the demo rule answers "안 쓰기로 했어", the scene face is set to 'calm' for 4 seconds. That is the half-closed, slanted-lid face, which reads as displeased. Hard line 4 asks for a plain refusal with no sulky face. docs/SALON.md §3.3 and §3.4 avoid this face for exactly that reason and use the neutral face for "그대로". The line is unchanged from 1e1c18f, so the "final" branch did not introduce it, but its 11-11 gift commit edited the lines around it. The rest of the refusal is plain: a decision-only toast, a labelled log row, no sound, no retry.
findings.evidence: t2.log and t2b.log: every refusal (리본, 밀짚모자) reported scene expr "calm"; acceptances reported "happy"; the salon "그대로" run reported "idle" throughout (t5b.log). The face art is in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-welfare/portraits-idle-calm-happy-curious.png (second from left), composed from the repo's tests/evidence/portrait-*.png. I did not get a clean in-scene close-up: the octopus kept walking out of the crop.
findings.repro: node /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-welfare/t2b-gift.js (day 2026-11-10, name 뚜루: 리본 is refused), then read APP.scene.expression() right after the answer toast.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the neutral face on a refusal (`expressRow('idle')`, or leave the face alone), as the salon does.

findings.title: The octopus is placed upstairs whenever the player climbs, including in its drowsy window, and its nap waits while the player stays up
findings.where: /home/user/ppolppol-merge/js/scene3d.js:3304-3309 (octMountLoft), :3434 (called from the stair transition); /home/user/ppolppol-merge/js/app.js:1319 (watching() is false in a room, so the rest timer pauses); screen: 위층
findings.what: The owner asked for the salon upstairs (quoted at scene3d.js:391). The author's way of getting the octopus there is to put it beside the stairs each time the player goes up, if it is awake and at home. It is not moved when asleep, out, or during a departure or return, and it is never woken. It is moved while walking somewhere (the walk is cancelled) and in the awake window after a turn, when it is about to lie down. In that case the nap countdown freezes for as long as the player stays upstairs. This is code-decided movement shown as the octopus following the player; the earlier salon rule was that the octopus stays as it is until it has answered.
findings.evidence: t5.log: A1 awake, octUp true; A4 it was walking to the window, then octUp true; A6 asleep, octUp false; B1 out, octUp false; B3 it came home while I was upstairs and stayed down; C1 to C3 after a stay-home turn the rest timer read 22001 ms, then octUp true and the timer stayed at 11697 ms for 5 s upstairs. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-welfare/t5-C-up-after-home.png. t7.log: upstairs it stands still by the stairs for 60 s.
findings.suggested_fix: Options. (a) Keep as is: simplest, and the salon is always reachable when it is awake. (b) Do not bring it up during the awake window before a nap, treating that window like sleep: about one condition in octMountLoft plus the existing downstairs line. (c) Do not move it on climbing at all; ask from upstairs and let it come up only when it answers "바꾸기": closest to the old rule, but the most work. I recommend (b) now and (c) as the later direction.

findings.title: "이번 주에 사흘 들어오기" is a login-count task
findings.where: /home/user/ppolppol-merge/js/app.js:4280 (QUESTS entry 'days'), :4296 (questN counts S.user.days inside the week)
findings.what: It is not a streak: any three days of the week count, nothing resets, and nothing is lost. It is still a task whose only content is opening the game on enough days. When the first visit of the week is on a weekend it shows "1/3" and cannot be finished; nothing says so, and it can be swapped with 바꾸기. The daily entry gift already rewards showing up.
findings.evidence: t1c.log F: first visit of the week on Sunday 2026-11-15 shows "이번 주에 사흘 들어오기 / 1/3 / 바꾸기 3" with no other mark. t1-week.js: it appeared in the seeded list for week 2026-11-09.
findings.suggested_fix: Options. (a) Keep: mild, and three free swaps exist. (b) Remove it from the pool: eleven tasks remain and the list no longer has an attendance goal. (c) Keep it but do not deal it when fewer than three days remain in the week. I recommend (b).

findings.title: Two tasks pay the player for asking the octopus something; the walk ask also counts when the press wakes a napping octopus
findings.where: /home/user/ppolppol-merge/js/app.js:1718 (questMark('ask') in invite(), after wakeUp's caller path at :1726), :3245 (questMark('gift')), :4279-4280 (QUESTS), :4291 (slot 1 is always 'ask')
findings.what: The reward never depends on the answer, which I confirmed. But five tasks pay 12 shells and 2 seeds, and "문어한테 산책 갈지 묻기" (twice, always the first slot) and "선물 상자에서 하나 내밀기" are among them, so pressing the ask buttons now earns currency. The salon rule is that asking gives nothing, and VISION line 2 says shells come from the player's own play. Pressing "산책 갈래?" on a sleeping octopus wakes it (that was already so in production) and now also earns task credit. The owner did ask for the walk task (quoted at app.js:4273).
findings.evidence: t1b-week.js output: B1 forced stay-home answers moved ask 0 to 1 to 2 and then stopped, with shells 3 before and after; B2 a sleeping octopus went from sleep to anticipate on one press and ask became 1; B3 a press while it was out did not count. t1c.log D: after 바꾸기 the first slot became "선물 상자에서 하나 내밀기". t5b.log E: a salon ask left the week list unchanged.
findings.suggested_fix: Options. (a) Keep both, as the owner requested the walk task. (b) Keep the walk task but do not count a press that wakes it. (c) Also drop the gift task from the pool so that, as in the salon, offering clothes pays nothing. I recommend (b) and (c).

findings.title: A gift "no" lasts one day and the toast invites asking again tomorrow; the salon rests a declined colour for 7 days
findings.where: /home/user/ppolppol-merge/js/app.js:3242-3246 (per-day record and seed), :3243 (toast "오늘은 이미 물어봤어. 내일 다시 물어볼 수 있어")
findings.what: The 11-11 change does make the answer stand for the day. The next day the same item is rolled afresh at 65 % yes, so a declined hat is usually accepted within two or three daily asks. docs/SALON.md §3.5 measured the same effect for colours (95 % within three days) and added a 7-day rest so that a "no" does not wear out. The gift box has no rest. The same toast also appears after a "yes", next to a chip that reads "쓰는 중", which reads oddly.
findings.evidence: t2b.log, seeded table computed in the page with the game's own hash and generator: 리본 is n on 11-10, n on 11-11, Y on 11-12; 밀짚모자 is n on 11-10, Y on 11-11. t2.log: asking again the same day gives the toast, with wear and the offer counter unchanged.
findings.suggested_fix: Options. (a) Keep: one day, simple. (b) Rest a declined item for 7 days like the salon and change the toast to say it can be asked again in a few days. (c) Keep one day but drop "내일 다시 물어볼 수 있어" from the toast. I recommend (b) for consistency with the salon.

findings.title: Already in production: asking for a walk again right after a stay-home answer is a fresh roll
findings.where: /home/user/ppolppol-merge/js/app.js:1720-1721 (seq is part of the seed in invite())
findings.what: Not introduced by this branch. Each press of "산책 갈래?" is a new turn with a new seed. The weekly task does not add to it, since it stops counting at 2. But the gift commit's own reasoning (a fresh roll per press means the answer was not the octopus's choice) applies here too, and the gift box and salon now behave differently from the walk button.
findings.evidence: t1b-week.js B4: eight asks on 2026-11-10 with the real demo rules gave out, home, out, out, home, out, home, out.
findings.repro: node /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-welfare/t1b-week.js (block B4; set ONLY=B34 to skip the first blocks)
findings.suggested_fix: No change needed for this merge. If the owner wants the same rule everywhere, a stay-home answer could stand for some time; this is a design question for the core loop, where staying home is a kind of turn rather than a refusal.

findings.title: The chip dot has no text for screen readers and stays on a stale week until something redraws it
findings.what: The has-gift mark is a static 8x8 px square in the chip corner, with no animation and no toast, so it is not a nag. It carries no aria-label or title, so the claimable gift is announced only visually. After midnight on Sunday it stays on until the chip is next redrawn, although the gift it points to is already gone (see W1).
findings.evidence: t1c.log C1 chip: class "bag-tag pressable has-gift", aria null, title empty, ::after 8px by 8px rgb(136, 75, 43), animation none. "Monday same tab before any render" still shows chipGift true. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-welfare/t1c-C1-scene.png
findings.suggested_fix: If W1 is fixed by granting automatically, remove the dot. Otherwise add the state to the chip's accessible name and redraw the chip on the day tick.

findings.title: Upstairs, the mirror button shows while the octopus is awake downstairs and tapping it does nothing
findings.where: /home/user/ppolppol-merge/js/app.js:813 (openSalon guard: a line only when it sleeps); docs/ROOM_EXPANSION.md 11-11 note says there is no mirror button then
findings.what: If the octopus comes home while the player is upstairs, or is awake downstairs for another reason, the mirror button is visible but a tap gives no sheet, no toast and no bubble. When it sleeps the player gets the one line. A silent dead button is confusing. It is not a welfare problem: the octopus is not moved.
findings.evidence: t8.log: "came home while I am upstairs" octUp false, btnHidden false; after a finger tap on the mirror: toast empty, bubble empty, sheet false. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v-welfare/t8-b3-mirror-noop.png
findings.suggested_fix: Hide the button when the octopus is not upstairs, or show one plain line such as "지금은 아래층에 있어."

findings.title: The "no seeds" toast is out of date
findings.where: /home/user/ppolppol-merge/js/app.js:4334 ('씨앗이 없어. 들어온 날 선물로 하나씩 생겨')

findings.suggested_fix: For example: "씨앗이 없어. 들어온 날 선물이나 주간 선물로 생겨".

findings.title: The walk task is counted before the turn is known to have started
findings.where: /home/user/ppolppol-merge/js/app.js:1718 (questMark('ask') sits before B.plan; the failure path at :1737-1740 removes the trip but not the count)
findings.what: If the plan fails ("두뇌가 잠깐 멈췄어. 다시 한 번 불러 줘"), the ask has already been counted, so retrying counts twice. Read from the code only; I did not force a plan failure.
findings.evidence: Code order in invite(): questMark('ask') at :1718, plan at :1734, failure branch at :1737.
findings.repro: Make BRAIN.plan reject once and press 산책 갈래? twice.
findings.suggested_fix: Count after the plan has resolved.

findings.title: If the per-day gift record is lost, the same refusal is replayed and written to the log again
findings.where: /home/user/ppolppol-merge/js/app.js:3242-3245 (the record is set in memory; it is saved only by questMark when the gift task is on the list, or 1.3 s later at :3258)
findings.what: The answer itself cannot change, because the seed is day, item and name. But when another tab overwrote the record, or the page was reloaded inside the 1.3 s wait, asking again ran the whole staging again and appended another "선물 | … 안 쓰기로 했어. (데모 규칙이 고름)" row, instead of showing the "already asked" toast.
findings.evidence: t2b.log: 리본 answered "뚜루는 리본 안 쓰기로 했어." three times on 2026-11-10 after the record was replaced by a tab on another day and after a reload. "reload inside the wait (gat)": the saved record before the reload did not contain gat. t6.log: with both tabs on the same day, the second tab correctly said "오늘은 이미 물어봤어…".

findings.title: Two weak links between rewards and the octopus having gone out
findings.where: /home/user/ppolppol-merge/js/app.js:2975 (questMark('diary') only when a poster's diary is opened), :4420 ("문어가 산책 나가 바깥이 보일 때는 밭을 바로 톡 해도 돼"); /home/user/ppolppol-merge/js/scene3d.js:4106

The task "포스터 일기 펼쳐 보기" can only be done if a poster exists, and posters exist only after the octopus has gone out at least once; a new player must swap it. The garden plots in the scene can be tapped only while the outside is shown, which is while it is out; the same actions are always available in the 살림 sheet, and the owner asked for gardening while it is out.
